entry: int32_t ILC_Bridge(uint64_t op, const void* in, uint64_t inLen, void* out, uint64_t outCap)

rules.arguments: op, inLen and outCap must be < 2^32, else BAD_ARGS and nothing written
rules.return: >= 0 bytes written (<= outCap, <= INT32_MAX); < 0 ilc_error, nothing written
rules.fault: on FAULT, state may have changed and out may hold a partial reply; re-sync with GET_STATUS. Every other error writes nothing
rules.location: (outer << 8) | inner; outer = ilc_location, inner = element index
rules.digest: FNV-1a 32 (offset basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193) over settings bytes 16..size
rules.schemaId: first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of this file with LF line endings, as two little-endian u64 in HELLO
rules.generation: settings: >= 1; repeat with same bytes = DUPLICATE; same generation, other bytes = GENERATION_CONFLICT; older = STALE_GENERATION

items.name: HELLO
items.doc: in: nothing or one ilc_header; out: ilc_hello_reply

items.name: SET_SETTINGS
items.doc: in: ilc_settings; out: ilc_settings_ack

items.name: COMMAND
items.doc: in: ilc_command; out: nothing. 0 = queued, the outcome follows as an event; NOT_READY while the input service is stopped

items.name: GET_STATUS
items.doc: in: nothing; out: ilc_status

items.name: GET_SEATS
items.doc: in: nothing; out: ilc_seats_reply

items.name: GET_DEVICES
items.doc: in: nothing; out: ilc_devices_reply, 32 + count * 148 bytes

items.name: POP_EVENTS
items.doc: in: nothing; out: ilc_events_reply, 32 + count * 32 bytes, as many as fit

items.name: GET_SETTINGS
items.doc: in: nothing; out: the applied ilc_settings (generation 0 = defaults)

items.name: TEST_SAFE_POINT
items.doc: debug: run the settings safe point now; NOT_AVAILABLE once the boot started its init thread

items.name: UNKNOWN_OP
items.doc: op is not defined

items.name: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
items.doc: reserved

items.name: BAD_ARGS
items.doc: null buffer with a length, null out, or a non-zero upper half in op/inLen/outCap

items.name: BAD_HEADER
items.doc: wrong magic

items.name: ABI_MISMATCH
items.doc: record abi_version is not ILC_ABI_VERSION

items.name: OUT_TOO_SMALL
items.doc: outCap is below the reply size; nothing was consumed

items.name: TOO_LARGE
items.doc: inLen above ILC_MAX_RECORD; nothing was read

items.name: BAD_LENGTH
items.doc: inLen is not the op's record size, or header.size differs from inLen

items.name: BAD_TYPE
items.doc: header.record_type does not match the op

items.name: BAD_FIELD
items.doc: a field is out of range or a reserved byte is not zero

items.name: CONFLICT
items.doc: fields are each valid but break a cross-field rule

items.name: STALE_GENERATION
items.doc: settings generation older than the last accepted one

items.name: GENERATION_CONFLICT
items.doc: same generation as the last accepted settings, different content

items.name: NOT_READY
items.doc: valid request for a subsystem that does not exist yet

items.name: BUSY
items.doc: the command queue is full; nothing was queued, send it again

items.name: NOT_AVAILABLE
items.doc: debug op refused because the module's own tick owns the safe point

items.name: FAULT
items.doc: caller buffer unusable; state may have changed, out may be partial: re-sync with GET_STATUS

items.name: NONE
items.doc: a bare HELLO header may carry 0

items.name: INERT
items.doc: no hooks, no threads, no game memory access: not started, unsupported build, duplicate copy, or shut down

items.name: DISABLED
items.doc: co-op module switched off for this start, or the settings file could not be read (reason says which)

items.name: BLOCKED
items.doc: another co-op runtime is installed: nothing armed (reason_detail = marker bits)

items.name: STARTING
items.doc: the init thread is starting the input service and installing the hooks

items.name: ARMED
items.doc: hooks installed, waiting for the game to finish starting

items.name: READY
items.doc: hooks installed and the game is running; reason DRY_ARMED = every detour still runs stock

items.name: DEGRADED
items.doc: reserved: transition

items.name: FAULT
items.doc: start-up failed and nothing is armed (reason and reason_detail say where)

items.name: NONE
items.doc: FF12Hinit has not run: a stray load, or the loader has not called it yet

items.name: UNSUPPORTED_BUILD
items.doc: not the pinned game build; detail: 1 base, 2 headers unreadable, 3 not AMD64 PE32+, 4 timestamp, 5 SizeOfImage

items.name: DUPLICATE_INSTANCE
items.doc: another copy of this module already runs in the process

items.name: INSTANCE_GUARD_FAILED
items.doc: the per-process guard could not be created; detail = Win32 error

items.name: MODULE_OFF
items.doc: Co-op module is Off in the settings file

items.name: SETTINGS_UNREADABLE
items.doc: the settings file exists but could not be read; detail = Win32 error (0 = larger than 1 MiB)

items.name: SETTINGS_INVALID
items.doc: the settings file is not valid; detail: 1 syntax, 2 schema, 3 newer schema, 4 a value of the wrong type

items.name: TOGETHER_PRESENT
items.doc: Ivalice Together is installed or running; detail = marker bits (bit 31: a check was uncertain)

items.name: BOOTING
items.doc: start-up in progress; detail = ilc_boot_step

items.name: INPUT_FAILED
items.doc: the input service did not start; detail = its issue bits (0x100 = did not answer in time)

items.name: PATCH_CONFLICT
items.doc: game code differs from the pinned bytes (another mod or build); detail = patch result | (site row + 1) << 16

items.name: PATCH_BUSY
items.doc: a thread stayed inside a patch site, or its context could not be read; detail as PATCH_CONFLICT

items.name: PATCH_FAILED
items.doc: the hook transaction failed and was rolled back; detail as PATCH_CONFLICT

items.name: DRY_ARMED
items.doc: hooks installed; every detour runs stock, only the settings safe point runs

items.name: THREAD_FAILED
items.doc: the init thread could not be created; detail = Win32 error

items.name: SHUT_DOWN
items.doc: the game is exiting; co-op disarmed and the input service stopped

items.name: BOOT_ABORTED
items.doc: the game began exiting before start-up finished; nothing was armed

items.name: CHECKS
items.doc: host, instance guard, Ivalice Together, co-op module switch (FF12Hinit thread)

items.name: INPUT
items.doc: starting the input service on its own thread

items.name: RECHECK
items.doc: Ivalice Together checked again just before the hooks

items.name: PATCH
items.doc: the hook transaction (dry)

items.name: ARM
items.doc: the settings tick attached and the liveness record armed

items.name: INIT_CALLED
items.doc: FF12Hinit ran

items.name: GUARD_HELD
items.doc: this copy holds the per-process guard

items.name: THREAD_STARTED
items.doc: the init thread was created

items.name: INPUT_RUNNING
items.doc: the input service was started by the boot and is running

items.name: HOOKS_INSTALLED
items.doc: the hook transaction committed (hooks stay installed until the process ends)

items.name: ARMED
items.doc: the liveness record is armed

items.name: INIT_DONE
items.doc: FF12HinitDone ran: the game is running

items.name: CLEANUP_DONE
items.doc: FF12Hcleanup ran

items.name: SETTINGS_DEFAULTED
items.doc: the settings file or its switch was missing: the native default decided

items.name: TOGETHER_RESIDUE
items.doc: files left by Ivalice Together that cannot patch anything (settings folder, Lua menu)

items.name: INERT
items.doc: reserved: an inert build (no hooks, threads or game memory access)

items.name: SETTINGS
items.doc: settings staging and safe point work

items.name: STAGED
items.doc: new generation copied to the staging slot; applied at the next safe point

items.name: DUPLICATE
items.doc: same generation and content as the last accepted settings; nothing changed

items.name: IDLE
items.doc: nothing staged

items.name: APPLIED
items.doc: staged settings became the applied settings

items.name: BUSY
items.doc: a bridge call held the lock; try again next tick (never blocks)

items.name: PARK
items.doc: seat 0 = all guests or 2..4; arg0 0 = play, 1 = park. Live now; holds until a settings record changes that seat's parked field

items.name: MOVE_SEAT_NOW
items.doc: seat 1..4; arg0 = ilc_character 0..5. Absorbs the seat's held input and queues the move for the session

items.name: PAIRING_START
items.doc: seat 1..4; arg0 = inventory session (non-zero), arg1 = entry id. Proof by pressing A on that pad; P1 on another pad runs the guarded change

items.name: PAIRING_CANCEL
items.doc: seat 1..4

items.name: CAPTURE_START
items.doc: seat 1..4; arg0 = ilc_action (P1: P1 actions only), arg1 = slot 0..3

items.name: CAPTURE_CANCEL
items.doc: seat 1..4

items.name: RESTORE_DEFAULTS
items.doc: seat 0 = all or 1..4

items.name: KILL_SWITCH
items.doc: seat 0; arg0 1 = co-op off now, 0 = back on

items.name: SETTINGS_APPLIED
items.doc: generation; a = body digest

items.name: SETTINGS_REJECTED
items.doc: generation as sent; code, field, location

items.name: COMMAND_REJECTED
items.doc: generation = request id; code, field, location; a = command

items.name: COMMAND_RESULT
items.doc: generation = request id; a = command; b: PARK = parked seats (bit n = seat n+1), MOVE_SEAT_NOW = character | 0x100 (queued, no session yet)

items.name: PAIRING_RESULT
items.doc: generation = request id; a = ilc_pairing_outcome | other seat << 8 | learned xinput slot << 16 (0xFF none); b = entry id

items.name: CAPTURE_RESULT
items.doc: generation = request id; a = ilc_capture_outcome | action << 8 | slot << 16; b = binding kind | code << 8 when captured

items.name: SEAT_CHANGED
items.doc: reserved

items.name: STATUS_CHANGED
items.doc: reserved

items.name: DEVICES_CHANGED
items.doc: reserved

items.name: SEAT_P1
items.doc: seats[0]; also used for top-level fields

items.name: KILL_SWITCH
items.doc: settings.kill_switch

items.name: ALIAS_0
items.doc: aliases[n] is ALIAS_0 + n

items.name: VAAN
items.doc: party member index

items.name: AUTO
items.doc: first free regular at session start; for P1, keep the current character

items.name: NONE
items.doc: no character (guests only)

items.name: SAPPHIRE
items.doc: target-circle palette index

items.name: CHARACTER
items.doc: colours follow characters

items.name: PLAYER
items.doc: colours follow seats

items.name: XINPUT
items.doc: xinput_slot 0..3

items.name: SDL
items.doc: identity

items.name: NONE
items.doc: code 0

items.name: KEY
items.doc: code = virtual-key 1..255

items.name: MOUSE
items.doc: code 1 = left, 2 = right

items.name: PAD
items.doc: code = ilc_pad_control on the seat's own pad

items.name: TOGGLE_CONTROL
items.doc: seat drop-in/out key

items.name: MENU_UP
items.doc: P1

items.name: MENU_DOWN
items.doc: P1

items.name: MENU_LEFT
items.doc: P1

items.name: MENU_RIGHT
items.doc: P1

items.name: CONFIRM
items.doc: P1

items.name: CANCEL
items.doc: P1

items.name: PARTY
items.doc: P1

items.name: PAUSE
items.doc: P1

items.name: HAS_DEVICE
items.doc: configured device is not NONE

items.name: HAS_KBM
items.doc: seat owns keyboard and mouse (kbm_seat)

items.name: PLAYING
items.doc: configured: owns an input and is not parked

items.name: LOCKED
items.doc: P1

items.name: LIVE
items.doc: a session is running (never set in v1)

items.name: BENCHED
items.doc: live only

items.name: NOT_RUNNING
items.doc: the session core has not started (module not armed)

items.name: NO_WORLD
items.doc: title screen, start-up or game over screen: no game world

items.name: LOADING
items.doc: a world exists but the party or the area is still settling

items.name: CUTSCENE
items.doc: the player has no control (cutscene or scripted dialogue)

items.name: MENU
items.doc: a native menu or modal interaction owns the screen

items.name: FIELD
items.doc: play: seats with a character may steer it

items.name: PARTY_DOWN
items.doc: every party member is down: the game's own recovery runs

items.name: NOT_READY
items.doc: input service not built yet: show discovery unavailable

items.name: READY
items.doc: the input service runs; the inventory is current

items.name: INPUT_ISOLATION
items.doc: guest pads and keyboard never drive the game

items.name: MOVEMENT
items.doc: follower steering and movement hooks

items.name: PARTY
items.doc: seat assignment, story guard, party edits

items.name: CAMERA
items.doc: shared group camera

items.name: FIREWALL_MENUS
items.doc: semantic input firewall and guest battle menus

items.name: WAIT
items.doc: Wait-mode participant rule

items.name: RENDER
items.doc: D3D11 overlay and panels

items.name: TARGETS_CARDS
items.doc: target rings, TARGET INFO and cards

items.name: READY
items.doc: proved on the pad; commit the device (and the alias if a slot was learned)

items.name: IDENTIFIED
items.doc: P1 proved its own pad: add the name or alias only, never reassign

items.name: PROVISIONAL
items.doc: P1 change: the new pad drives P1 now; press A on it again to keep it

items.name: CONFIRMED
items.doc: P1 change confirmed on the new pad: commit it; not seen in 5 s -> REVERTED

items.name: REVERTED
items.doc: P1 change undone: no confirm (10 s) or no commit; P1 is on its configured pad

items.name: CANCELLED
items.doc: PAIRING_CANCEL, a newer PAIRING_START, a settings change or a service stop

items.name: TIMEOUT
items.doc: no proof within 20 s

items.name: HELD_A
items.doc: timed out with an A button held throughout: release A first

items.name: DISCONNECTED
items.doc: the pad went away

items.name: TWO_PADS
items.doc: more than one pad answered (hide duplicate virtual devices)

items.name: P1_LOCKED
items.doc: the pad is Player 1's

items.name: OWNED_BY_SEAT
items.doc: another guest holds the pad (other seat in a >> 8): offer a swap

items.name: STALE_SESSION
items.doc: arg0 is not the current inventory session

items.name: NOT_FOUND
items.doc: no connected pad has that entry id

items.name: CAPTURED
items.doc: b holds the binding: store it in that action and slot

items.name: CANCELLED
items.doc: CAPTURE_CANCEL, a newer CAPTURE_START or a service stop

items.name: TIMEOUT
items.doc: no fresh press within 20 s

items.name: NO_INPUT
items.doc: the seat has no connected pad and does not own the keyboard

fields.name: size
fields.doc: whole record in bytes, header included

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: settings generation, command request id, or 0

fields.name: code
fields.doc: depends on kind; 0 when kind is NONE

fields.name: guid
fields.doc: SDL joystick GUID; not all zero when used

fields.name: uid
fields.doc: first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the casefolded device path; zero unless has_uid

fields.name: ordinal
fields.doc: tells identical models apart when there is no uid

fields.name: name
fields.doc: UTF-8, no control characters; zero after name_len

fields.name: sdl
fields.doc: when kind is SDL, else all zero

fields.name: character
fields.doc: seat character (P1: preference): 0..5, AUTO, NONE (not P1)

fields.name: seat_ui_sounds
fields.doc: battle menu sounds for this seat

fields.name: parked
fields.doc: seat parked (guest sits out); P1 must be 0

fields.name: device
fields.doc: the seat's input device and its identity

fields.name: present
fields.doc: Legacy MP economy detected by Lua; all other fields 0 when not

fields.name: module_enabled_at_start
fields.doc: module switch as Lua sees it; native reads coop.json at start

fields.name: kbm_seat
fields.doc: seat that owns keyboard and mouse; 0 none, 1..ACTIVE_SEATS_MAX

fields.name: alias_count
fields.doc: aliases in use; the rest are all zero

fields.name: kill_switch
fields.doc: co-op kill switch binding; keyboard or mouse only

fields.name: header
fields.doc: record_type COMMAND; generation = request id, non-zero

fields.name: seat
fields.doc: 0 = all/none, 1..ACTIVE_SEATS_MAX; allowed values depend on the command

fields.name: ops_mask
fields.doc: bit n set = op n implemented (ops 1..31)

fields.name: source_id
fields.doc: first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of the module sources

fields.name: schema_id
fields.doc: first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of schema/bridge-abi-v1.json (LF)

fields.name: accepted_digest
fields.doc: FNV-1a 32 of the accepted record's bytes 16..size

fields.name: applied_digest
fields.doc: FNV-1a 32 of the applied record's bytes 16..size

fields.name: safe_points
fields.doc: safe point runs, busy ones included

fields.name: live_member
fields.doc: character the seat controls now (0..5); NONE without one or without a session

fields.name: seat_generation
fields.doc: incarnation of the seat's character (changes when the game rebuilds it); 0 without one

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: session epoch: changes at every map jump, load, title screen and game over (0 = no session)

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: monotonic from 1; a gap means events were dropped
